difficulty_reason: Equivalence: (1) implies (2) by taking R = U x_X U from a finite flat fp presentation, giving the groupoid with s,t finite locally free and [U/R] = X; (2) implies (1) by recognizing X = [U/R] as algebraic, U -> X flat lfp, and checking finiteness of U -> X on the 2-cartesian projection R -> U; the final statement derives qc, quasi-DM and separatedness from the presentation lemmas.
